Belly: The abdomen, the part of the body between the chest and the pelvis.
Ear: The organ of hearing located on the sides of the head.
Elbow: The joint connecting the upper arm and forearm.
Eye: The organ of sight, located in the eye socket of the skull.
Foot: The lower extremity of the leg, below the ankle.
Hand: The distal part of the upper limb, beyond the wrist.
Knee: The joint connecting the thigh and the lower leg.
Neck: The part of the body connecting the head to the torso.
Nose: The facial organ responsible for smell and breathing.
Shoulders: The joint connecting the arm to the torso at the top.
